name: Spartina 449
notes: Store meta: Bluffton, South Carolina, USD, ships to 33 countries incl. US, CA, GB, AU (https://spartina449.com/meta.json). Story: began in 2009, founder Kay Stanley on Daufuskie Island, 'how linen and leather could marry with colorful patterns and timeless island stories' (https://spartina449.com/pages/our-story). Stores page: 'a Hilton Head Island based women's handbag and accessory company', lists its own stores (Savannah, Sarasota, St. Augustine and more) (https://spartina449.com/pages/location-spartina449-stores).

Free standard U.S. shipping on orders of $150 or more, contiguous US (https://spartina449.com/policies/shipping-policy). Returns within 30 days of receipt, $9.95 deducted when using its label; international orders not returnable (https://spartina449.com/policies/refund-policy).
